Inside the instrument +

Every note starts with a nonlinear felt hammer interacting with a string model. Fractional delays set the pitch; filters shape string stiffness and energy loss. Slightly detuned strings create the moving, beating sound of a piano.

Held keys and the sustain pedal let other strings resonate in sympathy. Twelve soundboard modes add body, while a separate room response adds space. Adjust Soundboard and Sympathetic to taste. This is an experimental acoustic model, built entirely in JavaScript.
